reviews.reviewText:
MCQs were all from handouts.

Short Questions:
1. Difference between Refactoring and Optimization.
2. Identify types of duplicated code.
3. Explain Open Layer.

Long Questions:
1. Write names of 4+1 view model.
2. 3 Benefits of correct exception handling.
3. Key aspects of Architectural Style.

Note: MCQs and subjective questions were largely from these videos:
1. https://youtu.be/aTBFXbjDuqE?si=0Em0s8r0xYcT8ZYG
2. https://youtu.be/y-OwXBUmAJU?si=zGXzENH76Te0hs5d

MCQs were from PPTs. The paper was neither too easy nor too difficult.

Short Questions:
1. 3 properties of system at run time.
2. Benefits of refactoring.
3. Write 2 points to improve availability of system in cloud computing.

Long Questions:
1. A code was given to refactor using Extract Method and write steps.
2. 2 deployment models of Cloud Computing.
3. Problems of Refactoring.
4. Scenario: Identify and explain architectural pattern for a system where modules are developed and maintained independently.
